integrity: The proof uses the source's exact extension/probability identity and pair-merging formula, permutation symmetry of the uniform distribution, an explicit derivative of the source polynomial, and a finite multiplicity sum. The packaged exact-rational verifier independently checks the coefficient against direct Hessian enumeration in several admissible cases; the finite checks are not used to prove the general theorem.
scientific_limitations: The result is a local stability expansion for fixed admissible d and q. It controls only modulus perturbations, because phases are invisible to the endpoint norm. It does not give a sharp global stability inequality or growing-parameter asymptotics. The full text of the 1973 Schur-concavity antecedent was not accessible during the literature comparison.
title: Isotropic quadratic stability at the uniform finite-field moment-curve extremizer
